name: My☆Sister ~Sweet Gemini~
source:
The game's objective is quite simple. You are a 'brother' and you need to 'take care' of your 'sisters' and 'friends'. There are 5 heroines in total.

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=349&style=alphabetical]AnimeDensetsu[/url]]
translation:
游戏的目标非常简单。你是一个‘兄弟’，你需要‘照顾’你的‘姐妹’和‘朋友’。女主角一共有5位。

[来自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=349&style=alphabetical]AnimeDensetsu[/url]]
